scenario: Debating the pros and cons of remote work
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ana amfani da shi a cikin fasaha mai girma don yin magana game da alheru.
Yanayen fasaha mai haske don yin juna; ana shigarwa a fagu ko tsaye a cikin jumla.
A wannan yanayin, yana nufin 'matsala'.
Ana amfani da shi don nuna yadda ake yin magana game da yuwuwar abu.
A ƙarshe na jumla, yana nufin 'amma' ko 'har yanzu'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: One clear benefit of remote work is that it can increase your productivity, don't you think?
dialogue.translation: Wani faɗa mai haske na yin aiki na nomanin ya iya cinye da yawa na samun fasaha, ba ka yarda?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true for some people. However, I've noticed several issues with it.
dialogue.translation: Wannan daidai ne ga wasu mutane. Amma, na lura da wasu matsaloli da shi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What kind of issues? I think most problems are similar to those you'd face in an office.
dialogue.translation: Waɗanne matsaloli? Ina ganin yawancin matsaloli suna daidai da waɗanne za ka faced a cikin ofis.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, remote work may require a lot of self-discipline. If you don't manage your time well, you'll likely fall behind.
dialogue.translation: To, aiki na nomanin ya buƙatar da yawa na tsarawa da kansa. Idan ba ka gudanar da lokacinka da kyau, ya zama ya tsaya da ƙasa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see your point. But companies should provide proper training and tools to help employees, though.
dialogue.translation: Na gane ma'ana. Amma, masu aiki da yawa suke buƙatar ba da fasaha da kayan aiki masu kyau don taimaka wa masu aiki, har yanzu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, they should. Therefore, it's not just about the employee's effort; the employer also has a role.
dialogue.translation: Ee, suke. Saboda haka, ba kawai game da jarabawa na mai aiki ne; mai aiki ma ya samu wani yawu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. And I believe the flexibility remote work offers is a huge benefit that many people value.
dialogue.translation: Da yawa. Kuma ina ganin rashin hada da yin aiki na nomanin ya samar da faɗa mai girma da yawa mutane suka dace da shi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree, as long as we address the issues we mentioned. Then it can work well for everyone.
dialogue.translation: Na yarda, har ma idan muna tattaunawa da matsaloli da muka yi magana. Wannan ya iya aiki da kyau ga dukan mutane.

key_phrases.translation: daidai da waɗanne za ka faced
buƙatar da yawa na tsarawa da kansa
ya zama ya tsaya da ƙasa
Saboda haka, ba kawai game da

scenario: Discussing a complex ethical dilemma
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ana amfani da cewa: tsaye yin wani abu.
A wannan yanayi, yana nufin sababbi ko matsayi saboda wani abu.
Yana nufin shawarar tsakanin biyu ko fiye da manyan zaɓuwan.
Wanda zai iya zama maimakon da yake: to concern = damuwa.
Yana da alama da cewa: duba yin wani abu.
Yana da alama da cewa: ko da wani abu ko yin wani abu, ba da wani kalma mai yin aiki ba.
Yana da alama da cewa: yana da alaka da dabi’un ko dabi’arsa.
Yana nufin ba da damuwa ko ba da alamar da yake.
Yana da alama da cewa: shiga cikin yin wani abu.
Wanda zai iya zama maimakon da result, amma yana da alaka da yanayin da ke da sababbi.
Zai iya zama mai alaka da jiki ko mai alaka da ma’ana (mataki mai yawa, mataki na kasuwanci, etc.).
A karshen jimawa zai nuna 'duka dai' ko 'duka dai ba'. Ba zai iya zama da 'though' mai yin aiki ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to decide whether to expose the company's mistake, even though it could cause a huge scandal.
dialogue.translation: Muna buƙatun tantance ko mu fitar da kuskure na company, ko da zai iya sanya muku matsala mai girma.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a serious ethical concern. But first, let's consider the outcome of each possible choice.
dialogue.translation: Wannan matsala mai girma ce na dabi’un. Amma fannin, mu duba saukarwa na kowane zaɓi mai damuwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: If we ignore it, we might avoid immediate problems, but the long-term damage to our reputation could be worse.
dialogue.translation: Idan mu yi ba komai, za mu iya tsayen matsaloli na yau, amma lafiya da matsaloli na farin ciki za su zama mai girma.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True. Yet the pressure from the board to keep this quiet is intense. They don't want any legal trouble, despite the risk.
dialogue.translation: Gaskiya. Duk da haka, mataki da ke tsakanin masu shirye-shirye domin sauran wannan ya zama mai girma. Ba su son wani matsala na hukumomi, ko da risk.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, but our decision should not involve hiding facts that affect public safety. That would be wrong.
dialogue.translation: Na fahimta, amma shawarar mu ba zai shiga cikin yin ba komai game da bayanai da suka shafi amfani da al’ada na jama’a ba. Wannan zai zama mai laifi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree. Still, we need to think about the employees who might lose their jobs if we go public. It's a tough dilemma.
dialogue.translation: Na yarda. Duk da haka, muna buƙatun tunawa game da masu aiki da za su rasa aikin su idan mu fitar da wannan. Wannan matsala mai wahala ce.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. But supporting the right cause sometimes means accepting some collateral damage. We can't just please everyone, though.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe. Amma tallafin sababbi mai daidai kowane lokaci yana nufin yarda da wani sababbi mai damuwa. Ba mu iya murna wa kowa duka dai.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's present both sides to the board and let them decide, but we'll make sure our recommendation is clear.
dialogue.translation: Ka yi hakuri. Mu nuna biyu biyu ga masu shirye-shirye kuma mu ba su damar tantance, amma muna tsammanin shawarar mu ta zama mai haske.

scenario: Analyzing the impact of social media on society
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ya zama da amfani don nuna sabon sabuwar ko canzawa da wani abu.
Ya nuna yadda mutane suka yi.

Da ke da alaka da jama'a ko fasaha da mutane.
Ya zama da amfani a karshen jumla don nuna fasaha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you think social media has a positive effect on our community?
dialogue.translation: Kun yarda cewa fasaha jama'iyya tana da hanyar fasaha mai kyau a jama'arta?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It can, especially when people share useful information, but it also affects our behavior in several ways.
dialogue.translation: Yaushe, mafi yawan da mutane suka yi da bayanai masu fa'ida, amma haka kuma ta affaɗa hanyar hannu mu da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And have you seen the data that shows how much time people spend on these platforms?
dialogue.translation: Da kuma kun gan podsawa da ke nuna yadda mutane suka yi da lokaci a cikin wadannan fasaha?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it's obvious that we're more connected than ever, though sometimes that connection feels superficial.
dialogue.translation: Ee, m ne cewa mu m ne masu haduwa da yawa a yau, amma a wasu lokuta wannan haduwa ta yiwu ta zama mai rashin matuƙa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, do you think the overall effect is likely to be more harmful than helpful?
dialogue.translation: Sai dai, kun yarda cewa hanyar fasaha ta yiwu ta zama mai laifi a gefe da mai fa'ida?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not sure. It depends on how we use it. For example, it can be a great tool for organizing social movements.
dialogue.translation: Ba zan tabbata ba. Ya dogara da yadda muka yi da shi. Misali, zai zama kayan mai fa'ida don tsarin fasaha jama'iyya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But it also spreads misinformation quickly, which can affect public opinion in a negative way.
dialogue.translation: Amma haka kuma ta yiwa da rashin bayani da sauri, wanda zai iya affaɗa ra'ayin jama'a a cikin hanyar laifi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. So we need to be critical and not just accept everything we see. That's the key, though.
dialogue.translation: Akwai. Saboda haka muna buƙatar muna da idanuna kuma ba zan karɓa duk wani abu da muka gani ba. Wannan ne matsayin kalmar hanyar fasaha, amma.

scenario: Presenting a business proposal
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Plan ko shawara mai fasaha.

Yanayin da aka nuna sabis ko sabon abu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm here to present our proposal for the new marketing campaign.
dialogue.translation: Barka da yini, dukkan mutane. Na zo ne in nuna mana shawarar sabon fasahar saitin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks. We have a limited budget, so we need to ensure every dollar counts.
dialogue.translation: Na gode. Muna da budgeti mai yawa, saboda haka muna bukata a tabbatar da cewa kudi kowane dollar ya dace.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Our strategy focuses on digital ads to reach our target audience more effectively.
dialogue.translation: Da yake. Tsarin mu ya kan tsaya akan saitin dijital don samun alamar masu amfani da shi da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But how can we achieve significant growth with such a small budget?
dialogue.translation: Amma yaya za mu samu fasahar mai yawa da wannan budgeti mai yawa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the budget is small, we can leverage social media, which is popular among our potential clients.
dialogue.translation: Duk da haka budgeti ya yi mai yawa, muna iya amfani da fasahar soshiyal media, wanda ya fi yawa cikin masu amfani da shi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds promising. What about our current campaigns? Should we replace them?
dialogue.translation: Wannan ya dace. Me ya kan da fasahar mu da yanzu? Shin za mu canza su?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We'll adjust them, not replace. Therefore, we can maintain brand consistency while testing new ideas.
dialogue.translation: Za mu gyara su, ba canza ba. Saboda haka, za mu sa fasahar da ke da alama ya dace da sabon fasaha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Alright, I see the potential. Let's discuss this further in our next meeting.
dialogue.translation: Da yake, na gane damuwa. Mu tattauna wannan da yawa a cikin matsayinmu na sabon taron.

scenario: Discussing mental health and wellbeing openly
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: A halitta da yin aiki da wani abu.
A matsa zurfin jiki ko zanen zuciya.
Yin aiki da yawa; a baya: improved.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been feeling a lot of stress lately, but I haven't talked to anyone about it.
dialogue.translation: Na yi da yawa da stress ne saboda wata lokaci, amma ba na yi magana da wani game da wannan ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's important to be open about these things. I found that talking to a friend really helps.
dialogue.translation: Muna da muhimman yin magana game da wadannan abubuwa. Na gano cewa yin magana da abokin aiki ya taimaka sosai.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know, but I don't want to burden anyone. I feel I should handle it alone.
dialogue.translation: Na sani, amma ba zan so in zama mai wahala waɗansu ba. Na jin in zan iya shirya wannan kansa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're not alone, though. Asking for support is a sign of strength, not weakness.
dialogue.translation: Ba ka da wani ba, duk da haka. Buƙatar taya ya nuna mai ƙarfi ba mai ƙasƙanci ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true. Do you have any advice on how to reduce this feeling of being overwhelmed?
dialogue.translation: Wannan daɗe ne. Shin da shawara da ke da kwarewar yin wannan ra'ayi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, since exercise works well for me, I try to walk every day. It helps improve my mood.
dialogue.translation: Ee, saboda yin wasanni ya dace da ni, na yi kokari in tafi wata rana. Ya taimaka sosai in sake da yawa na zanen zuciya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've heard that, but I never seem to find the time. Maybe I can go through a simple routine at home.
dialogue.translation: Na ji wannan, amma ba zan sami lokaci ba. Maybe zan iya bi da wata fasaha da sauƙi a gida.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a good start. Just remember, you don't have to face this alone, and there's always support available.
dialogue.translation: Wannan sabuwar fasaha ce. Kadai ka tuna, ba zan iya shirya wannan kansa ba, kuma da yawa akwai taya da ta zama.

key_phrases.translation: yi magana game da wani abu da buɗewa

scenario: Talking about urban vs rural living
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Amsa ne a karshen jimloli don nuna jarrabawa

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: After living in the city for five years, I'm seriously thinking about moving outside the urban area.
dialogue.translation: Bayan rayuwarku a cikin birni ne biyar shekaru, zan yi tunani da yawa game da matsawa wajen birni.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? I find cities quite convenient — you have access to everything you need within a short walk.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe? Na koyaushe sami cewa birni ne mai sauki — kuna samun damar dukan abin da kuna bukata a cikin yawon wata.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but the constant noise and crowded streets drain me. I want a more peaceful environment.
dialogue.translation: Wannan gaskiya ne, amma muryar da yawa da hanyoyin mai yawa sun yi mini rashin lafiya. Ina son muhalli mai zaman lafiya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. However, rural areas often lack basic facilities like hospitals or good schools.
dialogue.translation: Na fahimta. Duk da haka, yankunan karkara ko yankuna ba su da fasaloli na asali kamar asibiti ko makarantun da suka dace.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a fair point. But with remote work, I don't depend on the city for my job anymore.
dialogue.translation: Wannan matsalar daidai ce. Amma da aiki na nesa, ba zan daidaita da birni ba don aiki ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What about social life and career opportunity? You might feel isolated after a while, though.
dialogue.translation: Me yasa da rayuwarku da fasaha? Zaka sami jin rashin wata da yawa, amma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've considered that. But the cost of housing in the city is insane — I can't afford a decent place anymore.
dialogue.translation: Na bincika wannan. Amma farashin gidan a birni yana da wahala — ba zan iya samun wata daidai ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right, it's a real trade-off. Perhaps a small town outside the city could give you the best of both worlds.
dialogue.translation: Ka daidai ce, wannan matsalar ce mai wahala. Maybe a small town outside the city could give you the best of both worlds.

key_phrases.translation: daidai da yawa daga dukan duniya

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B

scenario: Debating environmental policy with a peer
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Yadda ake amfani da shi don nufin wata matsala ko wata muhimman.
Tsarin da aka tsara ko tsarin aiki, a nan a matsayin tsarin gwamnati ko tsarin ma'auni.
Yin aiki mai sauki; a cikin magana ya bayyana a tsarin da aka yi.
Wata abu da ke farawa; a nan matsayin asali na koyarwa.
Tsari na kasuwanci da ke ba da kayan aiki ko sabis.
Yin aiki mai sauki; ya bayyana a tsarin da aka yi da a cikin infinitivi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue with the new policy is that it's too expensive for small businesses.
dialogue.translation: Ina tunawa cewa matsalar da ke da sabon siyasa shine cewa ya zama da farashin da yawa ga fasaha mai yawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But we have to reduce our emissions somehow. The environment is at stake, and we can't just ignore that.
dialogue.translation: Amma muna bukatan sake yi da yawa da fashewa. Dajin ya zama a matsayin wata muhimman, kuma ba zan iya ganin wannan ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but the cost of switching to renewable sources will hurt the industry in the short term.
dialogue.translation: Na yarda, amma kudin canza zuwa asali masu sabis zai yi matsala ga kasuwanci a yaushe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: However, if we delay, the long-term damage will be even worse. We need to act now.
dialogue.translation: Dukan haka, idan muna jima, matsalar da ke da yaushe zai zama da yawa. Muna bukatan yin aiki yanzu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but are you against any kind of compromise? Maybe we can phase in the changes slowly.
dialogue.translation: Wannan gaskiya ce, amma ko ka da juna da wata irin wata yarda? Maybe muna iya shiga sabon sabis da baya-baya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not against compromise, but the current plan is too weak. Although I understand your concern about jobs, we need stricter targets.
dialogue.translation: Ba zan da juna da wata yarda ba, amma sabon tsarin ya zama da yawa. Ko da na fahimci damuwar ku game da aiki, muna bukatan sabon tsarin da ya fi tsanani.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I still think it's a risky move. The economic impact is likely to be severe, especially for rural areas.
dialogue.translation: To, na tsammanin wannan matsala ce. Sabon sabis ya zama da yawa, musamman ga yankunan da ba su da sabis.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And I believe it's a necessary risk. If we don't act, future generations will face a much harder problem.
dialogue.translation: Da kuma na yarda cewa wannan matsala ce da ake bukatun. Idan ba muna yin aiki ba, sabbin 'ya'ya za su faceda da matsalar da ke da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A

scenario: Discussing the gig economy and job insecurity

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. The gig economy gives you more flexible hours, but your income can change every month.
dialogue.translation: Na fahimta. Kasuwancin aiki na musamman ya ba ka kwanaki masu iya canzawa, amma farashin da ke samu zai iya canzawa kowane wata.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true. Although the money is sometimes better, I worry about the lack of benefits like health insurance.
dialogue.translation: Haka ne. Duk da haka, duk da yaushe kudi ya fi kyau, ina tsoro game da rashin fa’idodi kamar tsaro na lafiya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, many companies hire gig workers without any contract, so they don't provide any benefits at all.
dialogue.translation: Haka ne. Yanzu manyan kamfani sun aiko masu aiki na musamman ba tare da takardar aiki ba, saboda haka ba su ba da wata fa’ida ko wata alheri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And as an independent worker, you have to take on more risk because you don't have an employer to rely on.
dialogue.translation: Da kuma, kamar wani mai aiki na musamman, za ka iya samun hasara mai yawa saboda ba za ka iya biyayya ga mai aiki ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. Maybe it's better to keep a part-time job for stability while you build your freelance career.
dialogue.translation: Haka ne. Wataƙila yana da kyau ka ci gaba da aiki na kwanaki wanda ya iya ba da haskewa saboda ka ke gina sabon aiki na musamman.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea. I'll think about it, although I still prefer the idea of being my own boss.
dialogue.translation: Wannan da yake kyau. Zan tuna game da shi, duk da haka zan fi son nufin in zama mai masu aiki na kansa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Whatever you decide, just remember to save money for the months when you don't have a steady income.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe ka yi shawara, ka kalli ka ajiye kudi don watanni da ba za ka samu farashin da ya dace ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In a democratic system, the power comes from the public, but how much power does each individual actually have?
dialogue.translation: A tsarin demokaradi, ikarar ta zo daga jama'a, amma yaya wata wata mutum ya samu ikarar?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think the individual's role is mainly to support the system by voting, but the real decisions are made by a small group.
dialogue.translation: Na tsamman ne matsayin wata wata mutum shine taya tsarin ta hanyar yin sawa, amma shawarwari masu muhimmanci suka yi ne ta hanyar wata yaro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yet, a single vote can influence a decision, especially in a close election, so every vote counts.
dialogue.translation: Amma, wata daya sawa zai iya ya yi tasiri a kan shawara, musamman a yin sawa mai yin hasara, saboda wata daya sawa ya dace.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That is true, but the law often protects the interests of the powerful, and therefore, the common person may feel left out.
dialogue.translation: Wannan daidai ne, amma doka koyaushe ta kare manufar masu iko, saboda haka, mutum mai yawa zai iya jin cewa ba ya dace ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, is the public just a part of the machine, or can they truly shape the system?
dialogue.translation: To, jama'a ba zanɓe ne kawai ɓangare na masana'anta, ko za su iya tsarawa tsarin?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I believe the system is designed to balance power, but it only works if the public actively participates.
dialogue.translation: Na tabbata tsarin ya tsarawa don rage ikarar, amma yana aiki kawai idan jama'a ta yi taimako da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Then the role of each individual is not just to vote, but to hold their leaders accountable.
dialogue.translation: To matsayin wata wata mutum ba zanɓe ne kawai don yin sawa, amma don neman adadin masu jagoranci.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly, and without that support, the common good is often ignored in favor of private interests.
dialogue.translation: Daidai, kuma idan ba wannan taimako ba, alheri na jama'a koyaushe ya kashewa saboda manufar na 'yan wasanni.

dialogue.text: The biggest issue with AI in hiring is that it might have a hidden bias.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Do you have any evidence for that? I think AI can actually reduce human bias.
dialogue.translation: Ya zai yi da wata dalilai game da wannan? Ina girma cewa AI na iya rage matsa na mutum.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: There are studies showing that AI systems often learn from past data that includes bias, so they can affect certain groups unfairly.
dialogue.translation: A cikin binciken da suka yi, AI ta koyi daga bayanin da suka shafi matsa, saboda haka zai iya canza wasu jama'a ba da adalci.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see, but we should also consider the potential benefits for efficiency. However, we must be aware of the risks.
dialogue.translation: Na gane, amma muna bukatan ganin damuwar da AI zai samar da inganci. Wata rana, muna bukatan da hankali game da matukar.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True, but efficiency isn't the only factor. We also have to ensure that AI decisions are fair and transparent.

dialogue.text: Who is responsible if an AI makes a wrong decision? The developer, the company, or the AI itself?

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. The debate goes beyond just technology; it's about our society and the future we want to build.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. A joke might appear funny to you, but it can seem offensive to the other person.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe. Wasan da ya dora da wata matsayi mai kyau ga ka ne, amma ya iya bayyana da wata matsayi mai lafiya ga wani mutum.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, how do you approach humor at work, then? I find that a light joke can make the atmosphere more positive.
dialogue.translation: To, yaya za ka gaggawa fasaha a aiki? Na samu cewa wasan mai sauki ya iya samar da sabon matsayi mai lafiya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to use it, but the immediate reaction is not always good. Sometimes people just stare at you.
dialogue.translation: Na yi wata hara, amma fasarin da ya faru ba da yaushe mai kyau ba. Kwarai mutane suna ganin ka kawai.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right. I think the key is to maintain a balance. Don't force it, and read the room first.
dialogue.translation: To. Ina ganin matsayi ne ya kamata ka kare da. Kadai, kadai, kuma karanta wata matsayi da farko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True. If you do it too often, your colleagues will likely stop taking you seriously, though.
dialogue.translation: Gaskiya. Idan ka yi wannan kwarai, ya kamata masu aiki za su yi wata hara ba da yaushe, duk da haka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, humor is rather powerful. It goes beyond simple laughter. It builds bonds, but unless you are careful, it can also break them.
dialogue.translation: Iye, fasaha ta kwarai mai iko. Ta wuce da saukin wasa. Ta gina halaye, amma ko da yaushe ba ka jira da kima, ta iya rabuwa da su ko.

key_phrases.translation: karanta wata matsayi, duba matsayin mutane

scenario: Presenting a research finding
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Akan yi da rai domin nuna cewa matsaloli ya fi muhimmanci ko ba zan zama ba ne saboda rashin lafiya.
Ana yin amfani da wannan a matsayin jimla mai yawa a cikin Ingilishi na fasaha.
Waƙa mai tsaya, da wucewa -yze (rubuta da alfasar Amurka).
A cikin bincike, wata ko wata mutane ko abubuwa da aka duba.
Ana yin amfani da shi tare da 'to': similar to.
Ana yin amfani da shi tare da 'to' ko 'with'.
Akwai yawa da aka yi amfani da shi a matsayin jimla mai yawa: results.
A fasaha, yana nufin lura da wani abu ta hanyar koyo ko kayan aiki.
Tsari mai yawa na canzawa ko hanya.
Waƙa mai tsaya, yana canzawa da wani aiki.
Ana yi da shi tare da 'to': according to.

vocabulary.translation: duk da haka, ko da yaushe
vocabulary.note: Yana nuna wata yarda ko tsarki.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've finished analyzing the data from our latest survey. Do you want to see the results?
dialogue.translation: Na gama binciken data daga sabon tambaya. Ko kuna son ganin sabon fasaha?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, please! Did you compare the responses from the two different age groups?
dialogue.translation: Ee, da fatan! Ko ka faɗa amsa daga biyu daga cikin manyan fasu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course. According to the initial figures, the younger group shows a significant increase in usage.
dialogue.translation: Ko da yaushe. Bisa ga bayanin da aka fara, fasu na sabuwar jama'a yana nuna sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's interesting. Did you observe any other notable patterns in that sample?
dialogue.translation: Wannan da wucewa. Ko ka lura da wata patterns mai muhimmanci a wannan misali?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we saw a clear trend: the older group's numbers remained stable, although they started from a higher point.
dialogue.translation: Ee, muna ganin matsayi mai haske: fasu na manyan mutane sun tsaya daidai, duk da haka sun fara daga wata matsayi mai girma.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So the findings are quite similar to last year's study, but with a sharper contrast in the younger demographic.
dialogue.translation: Don haka sabon fasaha sun daidai da binciken shekaru da suka gabata, amma tare da tsarki mai girma a cikin fasu na sabuwar jama'a.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. This clearly demonstrates that our new approach is working as intended.
dialogue.translation: Daidai. Wannan yana nuna cewa sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon sabon

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Excellent. Let's prepare the final report and present these findings to the team tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Da kyau! Mu shirya labarin da ya gabata kuma mu gabatar da wannan sabon fasaha ga taron gobe.

key_phrases.translation: bisa ga bayanin da aka fara

scenario: Discussing inequality and social mobility
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Yana nufin kudi da aka samu ta aiki ko fasaha.
Farashin ko yankin tsakanin abu biyu, nan da ke tsakanin masu yawa da masu karfi.
Yanke nufin wata fasaha mai kyau domin samun wani abu.
Fasaha ko fasaha mai zaman lafiya na wani mutum.
Yana nufin tsokaci; ake amfani da shi tare da sunayen ko aiki mai yunwa.
Wani abu da ke nuna sabon sakamako.
Wani abu da ke nuna sabon sabon abu.
Yana nufin yin wani abu da ya fi kyau.
Yana nufin yin wahala mai yawa domin samun wani abu.
Yana nufin yin wani abu da ya fi girma ko motsa zuwa sama.
Yana da wani abu da ke da alaka da jama'a.
Yana nufin yawan kayan ko kudi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been reading about the income gap in our country, and it's shocking how wide it has become.
dialogue.translation: Na karanta da wata damar da ke da fage na inji a wajen kasar mu, saboda haka ya yi muguwa yadda ta zama da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but the real problem is the lack of opportunity for those from a poor background to improve their situation.
dialogue.translation: Eh, amma matsala mai girma ce saboda yanzu ba da damar wadanda daga asali mai yawa don sanya da kyau yadda suke.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Despite all the talk about equal rights, many people still struggle to get a decent job.
dialogue.translation: Tsakanin duk wata magana da ke da alaka da hakkin da ya yi, mutane da yawa suna yi wahala don samun aiki mai kyau.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Therefore, social mobility is almost impossible for them; they remain stuck in the same class.
dialogue.translation: Saboda haka, motsa jama'a ba zai iya ba don su; suna tsaya a cikin wata takamaiman sabon.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: However, I know a few cases where people managed to rise despite their humble beginnings.
dialogue.translation: Duk da haka, na san wasu cases inda mutane suka iya farawa tsakanin duk wata sabon sabon sabon sabon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But those are rare exceptions; the wealth is concentrated in a few hands, and that's the core issue.
dialogue.translation: Amma wadannan sun kasance sabon sabon sabon; damuwa ta kasance a wata takamaiman sabon, saboda haka matsala ce ta tsakiya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, what can we do to change this? Maybe better education is the answer.
dialogue.translation: To, me za mu iya yin wani abu don canza wannan? Maybe sabon ilimi ya zama amsar.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Education helps, but we also need policies that directly address the gap, otherwise nothing will really change.
dialogue.translation: Ilimi ya taimaka, amma muna bukata mu sami tsarin da ke da alaka da fage, ko otherwise ba zai iya canza wani abu ba.

scenario: Talking about leadership styles
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ya zama da yin wata aikin ko fasaha.
Yadda mutane suke yin wani abu.
Bayyana daidai me yace ake yi.
Taimaka wa ko goyi bayan wani.
Zabi tsakanin manyan abubuwa.
Gwamnati mai yawa da mutane suke aiki tare.
Yi nesa ko tsara wata jama'a.
Iko ko hakkin zama da shawara.
Iya canza wata abu saboda sabon halin.
Munadi, ba ya ba da damuwa.
Babuwa ko kula da wani abu.
Wanda ya sami abin da ya dace.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the best way to manage a project is to be flexible with your team.
dialogue.translation: Na gano cewa matsayin da ya fi dacewa don daukar da fasaha shine zama mai canje-canje tare da jama'anka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But if you're too flexible, people may not take their responsibility seriously.
dialogue.translation: Amma idan ka zama mai canje-canje da yawa, mutane zasu iya ba da damuwa ga wadannan abubuwa ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I prefer to lead by supporting others rather than giving strict orders.
dialogue.translation: Na fi son yin nesa ta hanyar taya da wasu saboda ba zan ba da umarni mai tsada ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: In my experience, a leader must have authority and make decisions quickly.
dialogue.translation: A cikin rayuwata, mai nesa ya kamata ya sami iko da yawa kuma ya yi shawara da sauri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the most effective leaders direct without being authoritarian.
dialogue.translation: Ee, amma masu nesa masu nasara suna sa hannu ba tare da mai iko ba.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right. A strict style can work, but it may not be the best for every team.
dialogue.translation: Maybe you're right. A strict style can work, but it may not be the best for every team.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. So, how do you usually manage conflict within your team?
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe. Don me, yaya ka koyi daukar da matsaloli a cikin jama'arka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to support each person and give them more responsibility when they're ready.
dialogue.translation: Na yi wata hanyar taya da kowane mutum kuma na ba su damuwa da yawa idan sun zama da damuwa.
